 LIVE! PFL Dubai Results: Nemkov vs. Bilostenniy
 PFL heavyweight champion Vadim Nemkov faces Sergei Bilostennyi
 by Guilherme Cruz Updated Nov 14, 2026, 2:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Vadim Nemkov and Sergei Bilostenniy face off at PFL Dubai PFL Guilherme Cruz is a Brazilian journalist covering combat sports since 2008. MMA Fighting has PFL Dubai results for the Nemkov vs. Bilostenniy fight card and more from Coca-Cola Arena in Dubai on Saturday morning.
 In the main event, Nemkov defends his PFL heavyweight title for the first time when he takes on Sergei Bilostennyi, who is coming off of back-to-back knockout wins over Renan Ferreira and Karl Williams. Nemkov is the No. 11 heavyweight in the MMA Fighting Global Rankings. 
 In the welterweight co-main event, the undefeated Patrick Habirora takes on Omar El Dafrawy. Habirora is 5-0 in the PFL, while El Dafrawy has won six of his seven league matches.
 Check out PFL Dubai results below.
